corrections.issue: Overstated causality. Alan says packaging track records with other indices is 'totally fair' and merely 'symptomatic' of an equity bull market, where any strategy coupled with the S&P looks good; he does not say the strategies look good only because of the packaging.
corrections.fix: Return stacking and portable-alpha presentations are fair but symptomatic of a strong equity environment, where any strategy coupled with the S&P tends to look good, so the packaged track record flatters standalone merit.

completeness_estimate: 0.87 - the first reader caught nearly every main thread (trend vs 60/40, narrative flips, AI-Fed analogy, Winton papers, performance data); missed several caveats and time-bound details and overstated one causal link.
